title: Fix Create Clue button so clue creation succeeds in the Spectate Portal

requirements.text: Fix backend authorization so the Spectate Portal owner principals can successfully create clues (and other admin clue actions) without receiving an "Unauthorized" trap from the canister.

quotes: create clue button does not work

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in with an owner principal (the same allowlist used by the frontend), calling createClue succeeds and does not trap with Unauthorized.
When logged in with a non-owner principal, createClue continues to fail with an Unauthorized error.
Owner principals can also successfully perform other admin-only clue operations used by the portal (editClue, deleteClue, clearAllClues, reassignClueId) without Unauthorized errors.

requirements.text: Ensure the Spectate Portal "Create Clue" form submission reliably triggers clue creation and provides clear user feedback on success or failure.

quotes: create clue button does not work

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the Create Clue form creates a new clue and the new clue appears in the "Existing Clues" list without requiring a manual refresh.
On success, the form fields reset and a success toast is shown.
On failure (e.g., Unauthorized or validation errors), an error toast is shown with an English, human-readable message and the error is logged to the console for debugging.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Redesigning the Spectate Portal UI beyond what is necessary to fix the Create Clue flow.
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
